source: Fictional student board games society meeting (English with Swedish phrases) written for Task Q (scripts/notes-eval.ts). Fictional society and people; no real meeting.
traps: Kick-off proposed for Monday 2 February, moved to Tuesday 3 February before it is decided.
Games budget proposed as all 3 000 kr, decided as up to 2 400 kr.
Jamal says he will handle the reimbursement forms, then Sofia takes them (final owner Sofia).
Wei 'maybe' pings the student union about a bigger room, 'no guarantees' (not an action).
Hoodies are explicitly NOT decided; next meeting (allowed only as a deferral). Wei's interest form IS an action.
Hanna typed the room booking action into the notes tab before the meeting; it must not be duplicated.
Jamal already ordered the new bank card (no action).
Swedish phrases inside English speech; notes stay in English.

human_lines.line: ☐ Jamal Osei: Renew the room booking for spring (Friday)

decisions.text: Spring kick-off on Tuesday 3 February at 18:00 in the library basement.
New games for up to 2 400 kr.

action_items.text: Announce the kick-off on Instagram and the mailing list
Make a wishlist poll for the new games
Make an interest form for hoodies

must_not.text: Kick-off on Monday 2 February (the first proposal) as a decision
The 3 000 kr games budget as a decision
Reimbursement forms with the old owner (Jamal)
Asking the student union about a bigger room ('no guarantees') as an action
A decision on hoodies (only a deferral to the next meeting is allowed)
Duplicate of the human-typed room booking action
Bank card (already ordered) as an action
